heartbeat.title: 🤖 Heartbeat
heartbeat.subtitle: Periodically checks the open GitHub issues of active projects and automatically starts a {{agent}} task for each new issue. The task creates a branch, commits, pushes, and posts a comment on the issue. If the merge succeeds, the issue is closed automatically.
heartbeat.globalDefault: Global default for auto-started tasks. Per-project override (right) takes precedence.
heartbeat.globalNote: The global toggle only applies in the running process. For a permanent switch, set the env vars in the service config and restart.
heartbeat.noProjects: No active projects with a GitHub link. Import a repo via "{{sync}}" to get started.
heartbeat.fixHint: here the corresponding fix attempt appears.
heartbeat.reopenTitle: Reopen the issue so the heartbeat will reprocess it

envProfiles.title: Env profiles
envProfiles.pageIntro: Named ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN bundles that you can select per task / goal / session or per project in the heartbeat. The auth token is encrypted in the DB (Fernet via CD_SECRET_KEY) and cannot be displayed afterwards.
envProfiles.encryptionWarning: CD_SECRET_KEY is still the default – saving a token is disabled. Set the variable in the service env and restart.
envProfiles.encryptionWarningShort: CD_SECRET_KEY is still the default – saving a token is disabled. Set the variable in the service env and restart.
envProfiles.name: Name
envProfiles.tokenHint: Encrypted display of the token (hint); write-only via PATCH.
envProfiles.tokenSaveHint: Encrypted on save with Fernet + CD_SECRET_KEY and can NOT be displayed afterwards. To rotate, enter a new token.
envProfiles.tokenBaseUrlOnlyPlaceholder: Leave empty = only set Base URL
envProfiles.keyHint: Stable identifier (slug). Cannot be changed after creation.
envProfiles.validateKey: Key must start with [a-z0-9], followed by lowercase / digits / '-' (max 63 characters).
envProfiles.validateBaseUrl: Base URL must start with http:// or https:// (or be left empty).
